lines.en: label nodokadorm5:
scene dorm2
I knock on Nodoka’s dorm and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Nodoka 的宿舍门，等她来开。

lines.en: : Heeeeeey! Uhh...come in?
Otoha answers instead.
lines.zh: 开门的却是 Otoha。

lines.en: Oh well. Close enough.
lines.zh: 算了。也差不多。

lines.en: : Why does that invitation sound so skeptical?
lines.zh: : 为什么这句邀请听起来这么没底气？

lines.en: : Well, uhh...it’s kind of hard to explain.
lines.zh: : 嗯，呃……这个有点难解释。

lines.en: : Nodoka, I’m inviting Sensei in. Is that okay?
lines.zh: : Nodoka，我让老师进来了哦。可以吗？

lines.en: : Huh? What? Yeah? Yeah. Yeah that’s fine. Okay.
lines.zh: : 啊？什么？可以？可以。嗯，没问题。好的。

lines.en: : The uhh...door is open, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 那个呃……门开着，老师。

lines.en: scene black
I open the door with a bit more caution than normal because I’m kind of used to either being invited in or not being invited in and entering anyway.
lines.zh: 我开门时比平时多了一分谨慎，因为我早就习惯了两种情况：要么被邀请进去，要么没被邀请也照样进去。

lines.en: It’s very rarely a gray area between those two things.
lines.zh: 这两者之间很少有灰色地带。

lines.en: But I suppose there are plenty of gray areas surrounding Nodoka if her talk about colors in the halls the other day says anything about the type of person she is.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，Nodoka 周围大概有的是灰色地带——如果前几天她在走廊上谈颜色的那些话，能说明她是什么样的人的话。

lines.en: scene nodokanodokanodoka1
: It’s wrong. It’s so wrong. Wrong wrong wrong wrong wrong wrong wrong wrong wrong wrong.
lines.zh: : 不对。太不对了。不对不对不对不对不对不对不对不对不对。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Don’t mind her. She’s just...doing a thing.
lines.zh: : 别管她。她只是在……搞事情。

lines.en: : And, uhh...sorry to be the bearer of bad news, but I’m actually on my way to visit my parents so...
lines.zh: : 还有，呃……抱歉带来坏消息，其实我正准备去看我爸妈，所以……

lines.en: : Either leave now or figure out how to deal with an over caffeinated and barely attentive Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 要么你现在就走，要么自己想办法应付一个咖啡因过量、注意力基本为零的 Nodoka。

lines.en: scene nodokanodokanodoka2
: FUCK!!!
: Jesus, calm down. You’re going to break your desk.
lines.zh: : 天哪，冷静点。你要把桌子砸坏了。

lines.en: : Is this how Nodoka writes? Or...reads?
lines.zh: : Nodoka 写作的时候都这样？还是说……读书的时候？

lines.en: : What is she even doing right now?
lines.zh: : 她现在到底在干什么？

lines.en: : No clue but...you know what they say about geniuses.
lines.zh: : 不知道，不过……你知道大家怎么评价天才的。

lines.en: : Do I? Because that definitely doesn’t ring any bells.
lines.zh: : 我知道吗？因为我完全没印象。

lines.en: scene nodokanodokanodoka3
: Well...uhh...
: Okay, see ya.
lines.zh: : 好，回见。

lines.en: : What? Just like that?
lines.zh: : 什么？就这么走了？

lines.en: : Yeah, my parents are literally outside waiting to pick me up.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我爸妈真的就在外面等着我呢。

lines.en: : Don’t you have any tips or anything?
lines.zh: : 你就没有什么诀窍之类的吗？

lines.en: : There are no tips on handling Nodoka. You just...do stuff and hope she goes along with it?
lines.zh: : 应付 Nodoka 没有诀窍。你就……随便做点什么，然后祈祷她配合？

lines.en: : Well that helps a ton. Thanks, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 这可真是帮了大忙了。谢了，Otoha。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, okay? But I really have to go.
lines.zh: : 对不起嘛，行吧？但我真的得走了。

lines.en: scene nodokanodokanodoka4
: Nodoka? I’m heading out. I’ll be back later.
lines.zh: : Nodoka？我出门了。晚点回来。

lines.en: : Nodoka?
lines.zh: : Nodoka？

lines.en: : Huh? What? Yeah. Okay. Bye. See ya.
lines.zh: : 啊？什么？嗯。好的。拜拜。回头见。

lines.en: scene nodokanodokanodoka1
: Umm...good luck?
lines.zh: : 嗯……祝你好运？

lines.en: scene nodokanodokanodoka5
Otoha, who already had her shoes on and bag next to the door, slips past me and exits the room, leaving me alone with someone who I’m not even sure knows I’m here right now.
lines.zh: Otoha 早就穿好了鞋、把包放在门边，她从我身边挤过去出了门，留下我和一个我都不确定是否知道我在这儿的人独处。

lines.en: : Hey. Earth to Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 嘿。Nodoka，听得见吗？

lines.en: : You feeling okay?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: : Everything is wrong.
lines.zh: : 一切都不对。

lines.en: : This isn’t how anyone with even a shard left of sanity within them would word this.
lines.zh: : 任何一个脑子里还剩下一丁点理智的人，都不会这么措辞。

lines.en: : IT DOESN'T MAKE SENSE!
lines.zh: : 这说不通！

lines.en: : IT IS INCOMPLETE!
lines.zh: : 它不完整！

lines.en: : THAT IS THE ONLY EXPLANATION!
lines.zh: : 这是唯一的解释！

lines.en: : Nodoka?
lines.zh: : Nodoka？

lines.en: scene ayhh6
scene nodokanodokanodoka6
: Hello
lines.zh: : 您好

lines.en: : What brings you here today, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 今天是什么风把您吹来了，老师？

lines.en: : Woah.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。

lines.en: : What dimension did you wake up in?
lines.zh: : 你今天是在哪个次元醒过来的？

lines.en: : I beg your pardon? I woke up in the same dimension as always.
lines.zh: : 您说什么？我和往常一样，在同一个次元醒来的呀。

lines.en: : Is there anything I can get for you? Coffee? Tea? Coffee?
lines.zh: : 需要我为您拿点什么吗？咖啡？茶？咖啡？

lines.en: : You said coffee twice.
lines.zh: : 你说了两次咖啡。

lines.en: : Coffee it is! Stay right there! I’ll run down the hall and make you some! You won’t even realize I’m gone!
lines.zh: : 那就咖啡！您就待在那儿别动！我跑下楼去给您泡！您根本不会发现我离开过！

lines.en: : I don’t need anything right now, Nodoka. Is everything okay?
lines.zh: : 我现在什么都不需要，Nodoka。一切都还好吗？

lines.en: : Hm? Yeah. Yeah everything is fine. Just a little tired, you know?
lines.zh: : 嗯？是啊。是啊，一切都很好。就是有点累，您懂的？

lines.en: : Sometimes you see so many words that all the words start blending together and then before you know it you’re reading the same word over and over and over and over again.
lines.zh: : 有时候你看了太多的字，所有的字就开始糊在一起，然后不知不觉间，你就同一个词读了又读、读了又读、读了又读。

lines.en: : Is there anything I can get for you, Sensei? Coffee? Tea? Coffee?
lines.zh: : 需要我为您拿点什么吗，老师？咖啡？茶？咖啡？

lines.en: : I...think you might need to slow down a bit.
lines.zh: : 我……觉得你可能需要慢下来一点。

lines.en: scene nodokanodokanodoka7
: No! Going slow will only slow me down! I’ve gotta go fast if I wanna speed up!
lines.zh: : 不！慢下来只会让我变慢！我想加速就得快起来！

lines.en: : Teach me about sex!
lines.zh: : 教我关于性的知识！

lines.en: : I’m sorry, what?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你说什么？

lines.en: : Sex! What does the penis feel like when it’s inserted into a woman?!
lines.zh: : 性！阴茎插进女人身体里的时候是什么感觉？！

lines.en: : I keep needing to guess and don’t want to appear amateurish to male readers!
lines.zh: : 我一直只能靠猜，可我不想让男读者觉得我太业余！

lines.en: : I must appeal to everyone! Anyone and everyone! Everyone and some people! But only if some people means all people! All people!
lines.zh: : 我必须吸引所有人！任何人、所有人！所有人，还有某些人！但前提是某些人指的就是所有人！所有人！

lines.en: : Teach me!
lines.zh: : 教我！

lines.en: : How much coffee have you had exactly?
lines.zh: : 你到底喝了多少咖啡？

lines.en: scene nodokanodokanodoka8
: Coffee? Do you want coffee? I can make you coffee. I make really good coffee.
lines.zh: : 咖啡？您要咖啡吗？我可以给您泡咖啡。我泡的咖啡特别好喝。

lines.en: : Okay, how many fingers am I holding up right now?
lines.zh: : 好吧，我现在举了几根手指？

lines.en: I hold my hand in front of Nodoka, flashing two fingers in front of her to find out if she can even see straight.
lines.zh: 我把手伸到 Nodoka 面前，比出两根手指，想看看她到底还能不能看清楚。

lines.en: She doesn’t have her glasses on and her pupils are like three sizes smaller than usual, so-
lines.zh: 她没戴眼镜，瞳孔比平时小了好像有三号，所以——

lines.en: : Fingers!
lines.zh: : 手指！

lines.en: : Yes. Good. How many?
lines.zh: : 对。很好。几根？

lines.en: : The more, the better! Shove your whole fist in there!
lines.zh: : 越多越好！把整只拳头都塞进去！

lines.en: : Okay, I’m calling an ambulance.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我要叫救护车了。

lines.en: : Two! Don’t call an ambulance! I’m good! Really good! Super good! So good!
lines.zh: : 两根！别叫救护车！我很好！真的很好！超级好！好得很！

lines.en: : Are you sure?...
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？……

lines.en: scene nodokanodokanodoka9
: Hah...
: Yeah. Yeah, I’m fine.
lines.zh: : 嗯。嗯，我没事。

lines.en: : Just...got a little riled up there for a second. Apologies if that made you uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 只是……刚刚有点上头。如果让您不舒服了，我道歉。

lines.en: scene nodokanodokanodoka10
: I’m ready for a normal conversation now.
lines.zh: : 我现在准备好进行一场正常的对话了。

lines.en: : You definitely don’t look like you’re ready for a normal conversation.
lines.zh: : 你看起来绝对不像准备好进行正常对话的样子。

lines.en: : Are my eyes doing the thing again? Have the dreaded bags returned?
lines.zh: : 我的眼睛又犯病了吗？那可怕的眼袋回来了？

lines.en: : Have my pupils shrunk to the size of dried, aged plums?
lines.zh: : 我的瞳孔缩成了陈年梅干那么大？

lines.en: : All of the above, actually. Is this a thing that happens often?
lines.zh: : 以上全都中了。这种情况经常发生吗？

lines.en: : Extremely. Though, I’m typically good at not letting people see it.
lines.zh: : 极其频繁。不过我通常很擅长不让人看到。

lines.en: : I appear to have reached a point in life where this is no longer doable, though.
lines.zh: : 不过看来，我已经到了人生中做不到的阶段了。

lines.en: : Just one of the cons of having a roommate, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 大概这就是有室友的坏处之一吧。

lines.en: : But I get to see her in her underwear every day, so it’s totally worth looking a little unkempt from time to time.
lines.zh: : 不过我每天都能看见她穿内裤的样子，所以偶尔看起来邋遢一点也完全值了。

lines.en: : Well...as long as you’re feeling okay, I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯……只要你觉得自己还好，那就行吧。

lines.en: : Never better.
lines.zh: : 再好不过了。

lines.en: : Hey, do you want to go for a walk or something? Maybe somewhere far away? Like far far far far away?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你想不想出去走走什么的？也许去个很远的地方？远到——远得不得了的地方？

lines.en: : Are you...trying to escape someone? Or something?
lines.zh: : 你是在……躲什么人吗？还是躲什么事？

lines.en: : Not particularly. I just get the urge to get out sometimes, you know?
lines.zh: : 倒也不是。我只是偶尔会有想出去的冲动，您懂吧？

lines.en: : I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : I don’t really think we should go anywhere with you looking like that, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你这样子，我觉得我们还是别出门了。

lines.en: : I doubt I’d be able to keep up with you at this rate either.
lines.zh: : 而且照这个状态，我大概也跟不上你。

lines.en: : Let’s go to that sex shop you’re banned from and buy a leash for you to pull me around on!
lines.zh: : 那我们去那家把您拉黑的性用品店，买根牵引绳让您牵着我走！

lines.en: : I’d never be able to escape that way! And even if I did, I’d come running home eventually because this is where all my stuff is!
lines.zh: : 那样我就绝对跑不掉了！就算跑掉了，最后也会跑回家，因为我所有的东西都在这儿！

lines.en: scene nodokanodokanodoka8
: Hey. Do you want to write a story together? That sounds fun, right?!
lines.zh: : 嘿。你想不想一起写个故事？听起来很有趣吧？！

lines.en: : Oh, shit! Have you ever done mad libs?! Let’s do that! That’ll help get the energy out! Right?
lines.zh: : 哦，操！你玩过填词游戏吗？！我们玩那个吧！那样能把精力发泄出来！对吧？

lines.en: Well, at least I understand why Otoha got the hell out of here as fast as she could.
lines.zh: 好吧，至少我明白 Otoha 为什么跑得那么快了。

lines.en: This is already starting to get exhausting and I’ve only been here for a few minutes.
lines.zh: 这才刚来几分钟，我就已经开始觉得累了。

lines.en: : Senseiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiii? Let’s play a gaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaame.
: Come onnnnnnnnnnnn. Play with meeeeeeeeeeeeee.
: What happened to having a normal conversation, Nodoka?
lines.zh: : 说好的正常对话呢，Nodoka？

lines.en: scene nodokanodokanodoka12
: Ahh, yes. Silly me. I did say I was going to do that, didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 啊，对。我真傻。我确实说过要那么做，对吧？

lines.en: : Woah, weird. What’s this?
lines.zh: : 哇哦，好奇怪。这是什么？

lines.en: : Sensei, do you ever see weird stuff when you close your eyes?
lines.zh: : 老师，您闭上眼睛的时候会看到奇怪的东西吗？

lines.en: : When I close my eyes? Not really.
lines.zh: : 闭上眼睛的时候？不太会。

lines.en: : Unless you’re talking about dreaming.
lines.zh: : 除非你说的是做梦。

lines.en: : I guess it’s like a dream but also kind of not like a dream. But still a dream at the same time. You get it?
lines.zh: : 我想那像梦，又有点不像梦。但同时又还是梦。您懂吗？

lines.en: : Nope.
lines.zh: : 不懂。

lines.en: : Are you seeing something right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在看到什么了吗？

lines.en: : Nodoka?
lines.zh: : Nodoka？

lines.en: scene nodokanodokanodoka13
: Nope!
lines.zh: : 没有！

lines.en: : All I see is my hot teacher standing there gawking at me.
lines.zh: : 我只看见我的帅老师站在那儿呆呆地看着我。

lines.en: : I’m starting to feel a little self-conscious, actually. I don’t think I’m very pretty without my glasses on.
lines.zh: : 说实话我开始有点不自在了。我觉得自己不戴眼镜不太好看。

lines.en: : I think you’d be adorable if your eyes were the right size.
lines.zh: : 我觉得只要你眼睛大小正常，就会很可爱。

lines.en: : That’s very sweet of you. Take six hundred Nodoka points.
lines.zh: : 您真贴心。奖励您六百 Nodoka 点数。

lines.en: : Woah. Are you sure? I don’t think you meant to give me that much.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。你确定吗？我觉得你本意不是给这么多。

lines.en: : Do you want me to take some away? Cause that just brought you way closer to tongue wrestling me before the end of the[school] year.
lines.zh: : 您想让我收回一些吗？因为那一下就让您离在[school]年结束前和我舌吻更近了一大步。

lines.en: : I will gladly hang on to them for now.
lines.zh: : 那我就先高高兴兴地收下了。

lines.en: : It would be nice if you’d go back to normal, though. This is slightly uncomfortable for me.
lines.zh: : 不过你要是能恢复正常就好了。这让我有点不自在。

lines.en: : Comfort? Is comfort an issue?
lines.zh: : 舒适？舒适是个问题吗？

lines.en: : Come with me! I know just the place!
lines.zh: : 跟我来！我知道个好地方！

lines.en: scene black
Nodoka swipes a notebook off of her table and runs over to her bed, jumping onto it and landing on her stomach.
lines.zh: Nodoka 从桌上抓起一个笔记本，冲到床边跳了上去，趴在了床上。

lines.en: Her long hair falls to her sides as she props her feet up in the air and waves me over.
lines.zh: 她的长发垂落两侧，双脚翘在空中，朝我招手。

lines.en: I decide to sit at the foot of the bed instead of on it because...
lines.zh: 我决定坐在床尾而不是床上，因为……

lines.en: Well, because I’m not feeling immoral tonight for some reason.
lines.zh: 嗯，因为不知道为什么，我今晚不太想干缺德事。

lines.en: scene nodokanodokanodoka14
: Is this better? Are you comfortable now?
lines.zh: : 这样好点了吗？您现在舒服了吗？

lines.en: : Wait, how are you supposed to be comfortable if you’re there on the floor?
lines.zh: : 等等，您坐在地板上怎么能舒服呢？

lines.en: : Come cuddle and do mad libs with me.
lines.zh: : 过来抱着我，一起玩填词游戏吧。

lines.en: : We can’t tell Futaba until you open up about your openness, though, or my chances of playing with her boobs get way lower than I want them to be.
lines.zh: : 不过在您坦白您的开放之前，我们不能告诉 Futaba，不然我玩她胸的概率会低得让我无法接受。

lines.en: : I should probably stay right here for now.
lines.zh: : 我现在大概还是待在这儿比较好。

lines.en: : Is this one of those unclear consent situations? Because I’m sure I don’t look it, but I’m perfectly competent right now.
lines.zh: : 这是那种「同意与否暧昧不清」的情况吗？因为我知道自己看起来不像，但我现在完全具备判断能力。

lines.en: : Go on. Ask me anything you can think of. I’ll give you the right answer.
lines.zh: : 来吧。随便问我能想到的任何问题。我都会给出正确答案。

lines.en: : I’m a prodigy, remember? A genius. I’m the smartest person you know. I see everything. I hear everything.
lines.zh: : 我是个神童，记得吗？天才。我是您认识的人里最聪明的。我看见一切。我听见一切。

lines.en: : Everything’s coming up Nodoka!
lines.zh: : 一切都在往 Nodoka 这边倒！

lines.en: : If you’re so smart, what’s the square root of 23?
lines.zh: : 如果你真那么聪明，23 的平方根是多少？

lines.en: : 4.7958. Next question.
: What were Thoreau’s last words?
lines.zh: : 梭罗的遗言是什么？

lines.en: : Moose! Indian!
lines.zh: : 驼鹿！印第安人！

lines.en: : I don’t even like Thoreau and I know that.
lines.zh: : 我压根不喜欢梭罗，可我连这个都知道。

lines.en: : Isn’t that more of a trivia question than an actual question, though?
lines.zh: : 不过那更像是个冷知识题，而不是正经问题吧？

lines.en: : Uhh...when did Toyotomi Hideyoshi die?
lines.zh: : 呃……丰臣秀吉是什么时候死的？

lines.en: : September of 1598 but the Council of Five Elders didn’t inform the army until a month later when they were told to withdraw.
lines.zh: : 1598 年 9 月，不过五大老直到一个月后才通知军队，当时军队已接到撤退的命令。

lines.en: : And those five elders were?
lines.zh: : 那五大老都是谁？

lines.en: : Ieyasu, Hideie, Toshiie, Kagekatsu, and Terumoto.
lines.zh: : 家康、秀家、利家、景胜，还有辉元。

lines.en: : Also want to give a shout-out to my boy Kobayakawa Takakage as the VIP sixth member that nobody ever wants to talk about.
lines.zh: : 另外我要特别点名我家小早川隆景，作为谁都不愿提起的 VIP 第六位成员。

lines.en: : And the electron configuration for Germanium?
lines.zh: : 那锗的电子排布呢？

lines.en: : [[Ar] 3d¹⁰ 4s² 4p²
lines.zh: : [[Ar] 3d¹⁰ 4s² 4p²

lines.en: : What the fuck are you?
lines.zh: : 你到底是个什么玩意儿？

lines.en: : That one was actually kind of tough because I almost gave you the configuration for tin, which is [[Kr] 4d¹⁰ 5s² 5p².
lines.zh: : 那题其实有点难，因为我差点把锡的排布给您了，那是 [[Kr] 4d¹⁰ 5s² 5p²。

lines.en: : I can’t help but feel like your omniscience is being wasted on sex writing.
lines.zh: : 我总觉得，你这全知全能的脑子用在色情写作上太浪费了。

lines.en: scene nodokanodokanodoka15
: Hehe~ Maybe when electron configurations and dead Japanese dudes can start giving people orgasms, I’ll be a little more interested in them.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~ 也许等电子排布和死掉的日本男人能让别人高潮的时候，我才会对它们更感兴趣一点。

lines.en: scene nodokanodokanodoka16
: Hey, how come you’re able to come up with questions like that off the top of your head but never want to teach anyone in class?
lines.zh: : 嘿，为什么你能张口就问出那种问题，却从来不想在课堂上教任何人？

lines.en: : Eh. I guess I’m the same as you in a roundabout sort of way.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我想，绕个弯子说的话，我跟你是一路人。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t call it roundabout. We’re both smart people who prefer to talk about not smart stuff. Done.
lines.zh: : 我可不觉得是绕弯子。我们都是聪明人，却更喜欢聊不聪明的东西。结案。

lines.en: : You are significantly smarter than me, so that comparison isn’t really fair to you.
lines.zh: : 你可比我聪明太多了，所以这个比较对你不太公平。

lines.en: : I mean, you knew all the answers to those questions too, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 我是说，那些问题的答案您也都知道，不是吗？

lines.en: : Definitely not the Germanium one. You could have said literally anything there and I would have believed you.
lines.zh: : 锗那题绝对不知道。你在那儿随便说什么我都会信。

lines.en: scene nodokanodokanodoka17
: You cheeky little bastard, you.
lines.zh: : 你这厚脸皮的小混蛋。

lines.en: : Also, would you mind explaining to me why we’re not cuddling yet?
lines.zh: : 还有，您能给我解释一下，为什么我们还没抱在一起吗？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t have playfully hopped onto my bed if I didn’t expect you to follow suit, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 如果不是期待您跟着上来，我才不会这么俏皮地跳到床上呢，老师。

lines.en: : And I’ve more than proved how competent I am right now, haven’t I?
lines.zh: : 而且我已经充分证明了自己现在有多清醒，不是吗？

lines.en: : What more do you want from me?
lines.zh: : 您还想要我怎么样？

lines.en: : A good night’s rest maybe? You look kind of insane right now.
lines.zh: : 也许是一夜好眠？你现在看起来有点疯。

lines.en: scene nodokanodokanodoka18
: Insane?...
: I’m sure it’s not that bad.
lines.zh: : 我觉得没那么严重吧。

lines.en: : When was the last time you looked in a mirror?
lines.zh: : 你上一次照镜子是什么时候？

lines.en: : Two days ago? Three days ago? Four? Five? Six? Seven? Eight?
lines.zh: : 两天前？三天前？四天？五天？六天？七天？八天？

lines.en: : I don't like mirrors very much.
lines.zh: : 我不太喜欢镜子。

lines.en: : And the last time you slept was?...
lines.zh: : 那你上一次睡觉是？……

lines.en: : I don’t know. I haven’t been keeping track.
lines.zh: : 不知道。我没在记。

lines.en: : I get tunnel vision and lose sight of things like that rather often.
lines.zh: : 我常常会陷入隧道视野，然后就把这类事忘得一干二净。

lines.en: : I was also particularly bothered by the way the air conditioner in this room sounds, so I had to get up to punch it on several occasions throughout the night.
lines.zh: : 而且这房间里空调的声音特别让我烦躁，所以一整晚我不得不爬起来打了它好几次。

lines.en: : It's so high up, though. I nearly fell off of my chair and cracked my head open.
lines.zh: : 可它装得那么高。我差点从椅子上摔下来把头磕开。

lines.en: : Then there was also the matter of the tag on my pajama pants bothering me, so I needed to deal with that.
lines.zh: : 然后还有睡裤上的标签硌得我难受，我也得处理一下。

lines.en: : But neither Otoha nor I had a pair of scissors so I needed to go acquire some and-
lines.zh: : 可我和 Otoha 都没有剪刀，所以我得去找一把来，然后——

lines.en: : You know, maybe it would be best if you just went on a trip to the bathroom and took a look at yourself.
lines.zh: : 我说，也许你最好还是去一趟洗手间，看看你自己的样子。

lines.en: scene nodokanodokanodoka19
: Well...if you insist.
lines.zh: : 嗯……既然您坚持。

lines.en: : But I can’t imagine it’s nearly as bad as you’re making it out to be.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，应该没您说得那么夸张。

lines.en: scene black
Nodoka hops off of the bed, leaving her notebook behind as she heads to the bathroom.
lines.zh: Nodoka 跳下床，把笔记本留在原处，朝洗手间走去。

lines.en: In the time it takes her to do that, I succumb to the desire to invade her privacy and peer into the pages I’ve been watching her absentmindedly scribble into.
lines.zh: 趁她去洗手间的工夫，我终究没忍住侵犯她隐私的欲望，凑过去看我一直看着她心不在焉乱涂的那些纸页。

lines.en: There are no words.
lines.zh: 上面一个字都没有。

lines.en: Just childish drawings of what looks like a house.
lines.zh: 只有一些幼稚的涂鸦，看着像一栋房子。

lines.en: scene nodokanodokanodoka20
: I take it your trip went well?
lines.zh: : 看来你这趟去得挺顺利？

lines.en: : I look like I crawled out of a well.
lines.zh: : 我看起来像刚从井里爬出来。

lines.en: : I honestly have no idea how you’ve been able to look at me for as long as you have.
lines.zh: : 我真不知道您怎么能盯着我看了这么久。

lines.en: : I think you’re cute. Just...cuter when you don’t look like a monster.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你很可爱。只是……不像怪物的时候更可爱。

lines.en: : I’d probably have sex with a monster under the right conditions.
lines.zh: : 条件合适的话，我大概会和怪物做爱。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene nodokanodokanodoka21
: Just think of...all of the tentacles and...
lines.zh: : 想想看……那些触手什么的……

lines.en: : Thank you for stopping by, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 谢谢您过来，老师。

lines.en: : Are you feeling a little...calmer now?
lines.zh: : 你现在感觉……冷静一点了吗？

lines.en: : Oh, not at all. I’ll probably go tonight without sleep as well.
lines.zh: : 哦，一点都没有。今晚我大概也会通宵。

lines.en: : But there is some solace in knowing that there’s someone else out there who can see beauty in horrible things.
lines.zh: : 不过知道这世上还有另一个人，能在糟糕的东西里看出美，这多少是一种慰藉。

lines.en: scene nodokanodokanodoka22
: So...if you’ll have me...I’ll be happy to continue being the girl you can flirt with in public that no one will get mad at you for since I do the same thing with everyone else.
lines.zh: : 所以……如果您愿意要我的话……我很乐意继续当那个您可以在公共场合调情、也不会有人生您气的女孩——毕竟我对其他人也是这样。

lines.en: : It’ll just mean a little more than normal with you than it does with them.
lines.zh: : 只不过和您在一起时，那会比跟她们在一起时多一点意义。

lines.en: : And the tiny girl with the black hair in the back of the classroom.
lines.zh: : 还有教室后排那个黑发的小个子女孩。

lines.en: : If you can get her to sign up for a threesome, I’d be more than happy to give you my-
lines.zh: : 如果您能说服她答应来一次三人行，我非常乐意把我的——

lines.en: : Stop dragging Sana into your sexual fantasies and appreciate her for the timid angel she is.
lines.zh: : 别把 Sana 拖进你的性幻想里，好好珍惜她那个腼腆小天使的样子。

lines.en: : Timid angel by day. Closet nympho by night. I’m calling it now.
lines.zh: : 白天是腼腆小天使。夜里是隐藏的色情狂。我现在就这么断言。

lines.en: : I don’t know if you being right will upset me or elate me...but I’ll take you up on that bet.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你猜对了会让我难过还是兴奋……不过这个赌我接了。

lines.en: : Winner has to do anything the other person says?
lines.zh: : 赢家可以让对方做任何事？

lines.en: : I feel like we both win if that’s the reward.
lines.zh: : 如果奖品是这个，我觉得我们两个都赢。

lines.en: : Oh yeah? But you haven’t even heard what I’m going to make you do yet.
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？可您还没听到我要让您做什么呢。

lines.en: : You haven’t heard my plan either.
lines.zh: : 你也没听过我的计划。

lines.en: : I just admitted to wanting to have sex with a monster. I’m pretty sure I could handle whatever you throw at me.
lines.zh: : 我刚刚才承认过想和怪物做爱。我敢肯定，您扔给我的任何东西我都接得住。

lines.en: : ...Yeah, you probably can.
lines.zh: : ……是啊，你大概接得住。

lines.en: : Here’s hoping this bet doesn’t take the next...forever to resolve.
lines.zh: : 只希望这个赌局不要花上……永远才能见分晓。

lines.en: scene nodokanodokanodoka23
: Want me to plant a seed for you?
lines.zh: : 要我帮您埋颗种子吗？

lines.en: : What kind of seed?
lines.zh: : 什么种子？

lines.en: : Maybe just warm her up a little so you can swoop in for the kill?
lines.zh: : 也许就先帮她热热身，好让您趁虚而入、一举拿下？

lines.en: : Please don’t do anything to her...
lines.zh: : 拜托你别对她做任何事……

lines.en: : Fine. I’ll just stick with my dear, sweet Miss Watabe instead.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那我就继续缠着我亲爱的、甜美的渡部小姐好了。

lines.en: : Yeah. You do that, Nodoka. It’s going very well.
lines.zh: : 嗯。你就这么做吧，Nodoka。进展非常顺利。

lines.en: : God I want to be that skirt.
lines.zh: : 天哪，我真想变成那条裙子。

lines.en: scene nodokanodokanodoka24
: AH! YES! I FIGURED IT OUT!
lines.zh: : 啊！对了！我想明白了！

lines.en: : Figured what-
lines.zh: : 想明白什——

lines.en: scene nodokanodokanodoka25
: YOU HAVE TO GO! LEAVE!
lines.zh: : 您必须走了！快走！

lines.en: : I MUST FOCUS!
lines.zh: : 我必须集中精神！

lines.en: : Well, okay then.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那好吧。

lines.en: : Goodnight, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Nodoka。

lines.en: : I see it...
lines.zh: : 我看见了……

lines.en: : I see everything...
lines.zh: : 我看见一切……

lines.en: scene black
I exit the dorm room and make my way down the stairs, somehow knowing less about Nodoka than I did before visiting.
lines.zh: 我走出宿舍，顺着楼梯往下走，不知怎的，我对 Nodoka 的了解反而比来之前更少了。

lines.en: I doubt I’ll ever get to a point where I know exactly what’s going through her head, but-
lines.zh: 我怀疑自己永远没法完全弄清她脑子里在想什么，不过——

lines.en: Well, at least it seems like an interesting place.
lines.zh: 嗯，至少那里似乎是个有趣的地方。

lines.en: Self-destructive, terrifying, and mildly arousing as well...
lines.zh: 自我毁灭、令人恐惧，还带着一点让人兴奋的味道……

lines.en: But certainly interesting.
lines.zh: 但确实有趣。

lines.en: I’m both jealous and afraid of how much time she gets to spend there.
lines.zh: 她能在那里待上那么多时间，这让我既嫉妒又害怕。
